notes.title: Update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

Just to let you know, I have uploaded a new build of this game that should fix several typos that were pointed out to me by observant readers!

I hope all the typos in this story have been squashed now - but you spot more errors, please let me know! Thank you!

- ebi x
